title: Categories
description: Configure product categories for catalogs across your tenant.

help.title: About Categories
help.overview: Categories are the product catalog's tree. They group products on the storefront, in filters, in discounts, and in pricing rules. A product can sit in several categories. Marketplace listings use their own listing categories.

sections.title: The tree
items: Name is required. The slug is built from it, kept unique inside the company, and rebuilt when the name changes.
Parent nests the category under another; leave it empty for a top-level one. A category cannot be placed under itself or one of its descendants.

sections.title: Where categories matter
sections.body: The same category is read differently by different features.
items: Storefront navigation, product filters, saved searches, and dynamic collections use every category of a product.
A discount aimed at a category matches when any of the product's categories is selected.
A pricing rule aimed at a category looks only at the product's first category.

sections.title: Deleting
items: Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored. Products keep their other categories.
The Odoo import can create and update categories from Odoo product categories.
